 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare account_plan text; current_count bigint;
begin
 select coalesce(plan,'free') into account_plan from public.profiles where id=new.user_id;
 if account_plan not in ('pro','business') then
  if tg_table_name='favorites' then select count(*) into current_count from public.favorites where user_id=new.user_id; if current_count>=10 then raise exception 'Free accounts can save up to 10 favorites'; end if;
  elsif tg_table_name='calculation_history' then select count(*) into current_count from public.calculation_history where user_id=new.user_id; if current_count>=20 then raise exception 'Free accounts can keep up to 20 calculations'; end if;
  end if;
 end if; return new;
end $function$
"}, {"id": "public.enforce_free_history_limit()", "acl": [{"grantee": "postgres", "grantable": false, "privilege": "EXECUTE"}, {"grantee": "service_role", "grantable": false, "privilege": "EXECUTE"}], "owner": "postgres", "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_free_history_limit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  current_plan text;
  current_count integer;
begin
  select plan into current_plan from public.profiles where id = new.user_id;
  if coalesce(current_plan, 'free') = 'free' then
    select count(*) into current_count from public.calculation_history where user_id = new.user_id;
    if current_count >= 20 then
      raise exception 'Free plan calculation history limit reached';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
  )::text
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$
